items.rationale: Clause 2.2 excludes breakage of glass components, and Clause 2.3 clarifies that only non-glass components are covered. Drilling a hole is part of fitting the replacement glass, which is excluded.

items.description: Installation of the new glass into the frame
items.rationale: Clause 2.2 excludes all work relating to glass components, including installation of replacement glass. Only non-glass components could be covered, but this line is solely for the glass.
Clause 2.2 and 2.3: Glass Breakage Cover is not included, so any replacement of glass components is excluded regardless of cause.
Clause 2.2: As all work performed relates to excluded glass breakage, ancillary charges (vehicle costs) are also excluded as they are not incurred for an indemnifiable loss.
